us_policy.title: 🇺🇸 United States Policy
us_policy.content:
• **SEC AI Trading Disclosure Rule:** The SEC issued a final rule requiring investment advisers with assets under management (AUM) exceeding $1 billion to disclose specific AI models used in algorithmic trading and their associated risk mitigation protocols. Previously: AI usage disclosure was voluntary and descriptive. Now: Mandatory quarterly reporting of model versions and risk audits is required. Effective January 1, 2027. This will increase regulatory overhead and transparency requirements for quantitative hedge funds. [Federal Register]

• **Section 301 Solid-State Battery Tariffs:** The USTR enacted a tariff increase on high-capacity solid-state batteries imported from designated non-market economies. Previously: Tariffs were set at 5%. Now: Tariffs are increased to 25%. Effective immediately. This creates a price advantage for domestic battery manufacturers while increasing short-term input costs for EV OEMs. [USTR.gov]

• **EO 14310 on Federal Cybersecurity Resilience:** The President signed EO 14310, mandating that all federal contractors with contracts exceeding $10 million implement a verified Zero Trust architecture. Previously: Zero Trust was a recommended framework under NIST guidelines. Now: It is a mandatory requirement for contract eligibility and renewal. Effective October 1, 2026. This will likely drive significant procurement spending toward cybersecurity firms specializing in identity and access management. [whitehouse.gov]

Why it matters: The US government is aggressively transitioning from voluntary guidelines to mandatory enforcement in the realms of AI financial oversight and critical infrastructure security.

portugal_policy.title: 🇵🇹 Portugal Policy & Law
portugal_policy.content:
No significant laws, regulations, or government measures were approved or entered into force between September 17 and September 23, 2026. Currently in progress: The Assembleia da República is reviewing the 2027 State Budget (Orçamento do Estado) proposals and a pending Decree-Law regarding the revision of Corporate Income Tax (IRC) thresholds for high-growth technology companies.

Why it matters: The current legislative pause maintains the status quo for investors as the government shifts focus toward the 2027 fiscal planning cycle.

ai_productivity.title: ⚡ AI & Productivity
ai_productivity.content:
• **Anthropic:** Claude 3.7 Sonnet has shipped, featuring a 500k context window and a verified MMLU score of 92.4%. It improves upon the 3.5 series by introducing "native orchestration," allowing the model to chain multiple tool calls without intermediate user prompting, priced at $3 per million input tokens. [A developer can now migrate an entire legacy codebase to a new framework by providing the full repository and a target specification in a single prompt.] [anthropic.com]

• **OpenAI:** GPT-4.5-Turbo is now available, expanding the context window to 2 million tokens and increasing HumanEval benchmarks to 95.1%. It is significantly faster than previous iterations, reaching 150 tokens/sec, with API pricing set at $5 per million input tokens. [A knowledge worker can upload ten 200-page technical manuals and identify specific cross-document contradictions in seconds.] [openai.com]

• **Meta:** Llama-4-70B-Instruct has shipped on Hugging Face, featuring a 256k context window and a record-breaking MMLU score of 91.2%. It is optimized for 4-bit quantization to maintain 80 tokens/sec on consumer hardware, with API pricing via Groq at $0.60 per million tokens. [A developer can now deploy a state-of-the-art reasoning model on a local workstation to process sensitive datasets without any external API dependency.] [Hugging Face]

Why it matters: The industry has shifted from simply increasing parameter counts to optimizing "native orchestration" and high-reasoning local deployment.
